tagline: The CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. The connector ingests Falcon Event Stream events from CrowdStrike Falcon into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The CrowdStrike Falcon Event Stream connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
